FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Update Specialist Death Handling
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: A couple changes to how specialist death is handled.

patchNoteLines.li: The player now always receives a letter if a specialist dies, whether it was in battle or not.
The RNG roll for post-battle specialist death only runs for auto-defense battles
